summary: Iteration 20: Full testing of under-raise rule (no_raise_uids) + side pot display. All 13 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified working. Under-raise logic, side pot computation, WS enforcement, and multi-pot UI display all verified correct.

minor.issue: Redundant no-op assignment: `room.hand.contributions[uid] = room.hand.contributions.get(uid, 0)` is immediately overwritten by line 626. Not a bug but dead code.

integration_issues.issue: Occasional 'Fetch error: TypeError: Failed to fetch' console warning during page load (likely from bankroll fetch race condition). Does not affect gameplay.

issues: When rawPots.length > 1, both MAIN and SIDE labels show in blue (#3b82f6) because isSide = i > 0 || rawPots.length > 1. MAIN pot loses its distinct gray color when side pots exist. Minor visual inconsistency but not a bug.

critical_code_review_comments: HandState.no_raise_uids: correctly implemented as set(), cleared in _advance_round ✓
_compute_pots: correctly uses bet_total (cumulative across streets) for live side pot calculation ✓
_send_valid_actions: correctly suppresses both 'raise' AND 'all_in' (when > current_bet) for no_raise_uids players ✓
_apply_action: full vs under-raise detection is_full_raise = raise_size >= min_raise_increment — handles negative raise_size (short all-in) correctly ✓
WS enforcement: game_ws handler converts all-in ≤ current_bet to call for no_raise_uids players ✓
Frontend pots interface: GameState.pots?: Array<{amount, eligible_uids}> correctly typed ✓
Frontend pot display: MAIN/SIDE labels side by side with player avatars inside oval felt ✓
Redundant dead code: server.py L625 `room.hand.contributions[uid] = room.hand.contributions.get(uid, 0)` is immediately overwritten by L626 — minor cleanup candidate

(7) Frontend: MAIN/SIDE labels with player avatars visible in oval felt ✓. (8) Quick login regression ✓. Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter20_underraise_sidepot.py (13 tests). WS tests use asyncio.run() with websockets library.
